page_title: CZE 1-1 SOU | Czech Republic v South Africa 18/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Mbekezile Mbokazi (South Africa) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
90+7' South Africa quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+7' Aubrey Modiba (South Africa) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. South Africa have been awarded a corner kick.
90+6' Evidence Makgopa (South Africa) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Matej Kovar is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
90+4' Lukas Provod (Czech Republic) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
90+2' Jaroslav Zeleny (Czech Republic) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+1' Kamogelo Sebelebele (South Africa) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Tori Penso signals. Czech Republic have a free kick.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
88' Relebohile Mofokeng (South Africa) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Matej Kovar stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
84' It's time for a substitution. Kamogelo Sebelebele (South Africa) comes on in place of Thapelo Maseko.
83' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Teboho Mokoena (South Africa) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Matej Kovar no chance!
83' Teboho Mokoena (South Africa) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
82' Handball by Pavel Sulc (Czech Republic). PENALTY! One of the players from South Africa is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lukas Cerv leaves the pitch and David Zima (Czech Republic) comes on.
76' Mbekezile Mbokazi (South Africa) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
75' Ladislav Krejci (Czech Republic) has tested the patience of referee Tori Penso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

75' Matej Kovar pulls off a decent save! Evidence Makgopa (South Africa) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
74' Oswin Appollis (South Africa) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
73' The attendance is 67442.
72' The match can continue after the interruption.
69' A cooling break is underway.
68' Ladislav Krejci (Czech Republic) attempts a nice header from inside the penalty area, but his effort is blocked.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tomas Soucek (Czech Republic) will replace Michal Sadilek.
67' Miroslav Koubek has decided to make a change. Lukas Provod (Czech Republic) replaces Adam Hlozek.
66' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Iqraam Rayners as he is replaced by Evidence Makgopa (South Africa).
65' Adam Hlozek (Czech Republic) commits a foul and Tori Penso immediately signals a free kick.
62' Khuliso Mudau (South Africa) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
61' Aubrey Modiba (South Africa) receives a reproachful look from his teammates after he attempted to surprise the goalkeeper with a shot from long distance. The ball flew far wide of the right post.

59' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
59' Lukas Cerv (Czech Republic) is able to continue to play.
58' Lukas Cerv (Czech Republic) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
55' Miroslav Koubek has decided to substitute Alexandr Sojka and he is replaced by Jaroslav Zeleny (Czech Republic).
55' The substitution is prepared. Pavel Sulc (Czech Republic) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Vladimir Darida.

54' What a poor attempt! Thapelo Maseko (South Africa) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.

53' Ladislav Krejci (Czech Republic) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
53' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) steps up to send the ball in.
52' Alexandr Sojka (Czech Republic) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
50' A quickly taken corner by South Africa.
49' Khuliso Mudau (South Africa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman points to the corner flag, South Africa are going to take it.
48' Patrik Schick (Czech Republic) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
48' The ball goes behind for a corner. Czech Republic will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' Lukas Cerv (Czech Republic) sends a rebound goalwards towards the top of the net, but the goalkeeper is there in time to stop it.

47' Vladimir Darida (Czech Republic) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Vladimir Darida (Czech Republic) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Hugo Broos gives a chance to Relebohile Mofokeng and Jayden Adams (South Africa) is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Thapelo Maseko (South Africa) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Teboho Mokoena (South Africa) attempts to put the ball in from a rebound with his long-range shot, but it isn't accurate enough, and the ball goes high over the crossbar.
44' South Africa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
43' Thapelo Maseko (South Africa) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
42' Adam Hlozek (Czech Republic) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
40' Tori Penso shows a yellow card to Thalente Mbatha (South Africa) for his blatant foul.
40' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
38' Oswin Appollis (South Africa) works the corner short.
37' Khuliso Mudau (South Africa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play and South Africa have been awarded a corner kick.
35' Adam Hlozek (Czech Republic) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Teboho Mokoena (South Africa) was quite harsh and Tori Penso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' Aubrey Modiba (South Africa) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
29' Adam Hlozek (Czech Republic) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
27' Iqraam Rayners (South Africa) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
25' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
22' The referee blows for a cooling break.
22' Aubrey Modiba (South Africa) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
20' Ladislav Krejci (Czech Republic) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tori Penso blows for a foul.
18' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Vladimir Darida (Czech Republic) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.

16' Matej Kovar doesn't have to worry about this one. Khuliso Mudau plays a pass into the feet of Thapelo Maseko (South Africa), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the right post.
13' Aubrey Modiba (South Africa) smashes the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after going way off target.
13' South Africa take a short corner kick.
12' Oswin Appollis (South Africa) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender. South Africa have a corner.
9' The game is interrupted as Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) is flagged offside.

8' Thapelo Maseko (South Africa) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Alexandr Sojka, then sends the ball inside the right post. 1:0.
6' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) attempts to put the ball in from a rebound with his long-range shot, but it isn't accurate enough and the ball goes wide of the left post.
5' The linesman makes the right call and Czech Republic will have a corner.
5' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
4' Teboho Mokoena (South Africa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tori Penso blows for a foul. Czech Republic are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
3' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

2' The ball goes out for a corner. Czech Republic can continue in their attacking effort. Adam Hlozek (Czech Republic) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' Patrik Schick (Czech Republic) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends his bullet header just wide of the right post.
